entities.name: Westcar Papyrus
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Westcar Papyrus is an ancient Egyptian text containing five stories about miracles performed by priests and magicians. In the papyrus text, each of these tales are told at the royal court of King Khufu by his sons.
